==Description==
'''Agent Duck Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] as a reward for reaching Level 24 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{DuckyEggs|780}} or {{Robux|78}} ({{Robux|66}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total cost of {{DuckyEggs|8,990}} or {{Robux|1,720}} ({{Robux|1,450}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale).

==Appearance==
'''Agent Duck Charm''' appearance is based on the [[Agent Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Agent Ducky]]. It holds its pistol while pointing it upwards. It plays a sound of a totem falling down with a duck quack in the background.

The color changes based on the player's username color, but appears orange in inventory preview.

*'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]]
**'''Agent Duck Charm''' added.
**{{Bug}} '''Agent Duck Charm''' shakes uncontrollably and can collide with players.
*'''23 April 2025''' - [[v1.62.0]]

*'''11 June 2025''' - [[v1.66.0|v1.66.1a]]
